name: Clay Coreling
description: A slow armored tank that shrugs off most wards. Impact wards are the only reliable answer.
lore: Clay corelings are squat, hulking creatures formed from the very earth. Their outer shell rivals stone for hardness and regenerates slowly when not warded. Jardir once watched a clay demon walk through a barrier ward net that would have stopped ten wood demons — the net was simply not dense enough to penetrate the thick hide. Only impact wards crack them open.
